definition_en: to save someone or something from danger or harm
core_image: 有人被水围住，救援者伸手把他拉上岸
scene: 洪水涨到窗台，消防员划着小船把一家人救了出来。When the flood reached the windows, firefighters rescued the family in a small boat.
sceneCN: 这里 rescue 是「营救」（第 1 个义项：把某人从危险中救出）；句意：洪水涨到窗台时，消防员用一条小船把一家人救了出来。

senses.title: To save from immediate danger
senses.definition: to get someone out of a dangerous place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 把某人从危险的地方或处境中救出来
senses.example: Firefighters rescued two people from the burning house.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员从燃烧的房子里救出两个人。
senses.why: The word begins with people in danger, so the core sense is physical saving.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从身处危险的人开始，所以核心义是身体上的救助。

senses.title: To save from a difficult situation
senses.definition: to help someone or something escape failure or embarrassment
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人或某物脱离失败或尴尬
senses.example: A last-minute goal rescued the team from defeat.
senses.exampleCN: 最后时刻的一个进球把球队从失败中挽救回来。
senses.why: The same pulling-out image is applied to failure rather than physical danger.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「拉出来」意象，被用在失败而非身体危险上。

senses.title: An act of saving
senses.definition: the act of saving someone from danger, or an operation that does so
senses.definitionCN: 把某人从危险中救出的行为，或为此展开的行动
senses.example: The rescue took place at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 营救行动在黎明时展开。
senses.why: The verb is also used as a noun for the whole operation.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词也作名词，指整个营救行动。

intro.en: Rescue comes from Old French rescourre, to shake off or set free, from Latin excutere, to shake out.
intro.cn: rescue 来自古法语 rescourre（抖脱、使自由），源于拉丁语 excutere（抖出）。

items.en: Quatere means to shake.
items.cn: quatere 意为摇动。

items.en: Excutere means to shake out or drive off.
items.cn: excutere 意为抖出、赶走。

items.en: Escourre means to shake off or free oneself.
items.cn: escourre 意为抖脱、脱身。

items.en: Rescourre means to set free from danger.
items.cn: rescourre 意为从危险中解救。

items.en: Middle English rescuen keeps the sense of saving from harm.
items.cn: 中古英语 rescuen 保留「使免于伤害」的意思。

items.en: Modern English uses rescue for danger, failure, and emergency operations.
items.cn: 现代英语中，rescue 用于危险、失败与紧急行动。

note.en: Rescue is a pulling-out word, and it sits near its own family and near verbs for saving and freeing.
note.cn: rescue 是一个「拉出来」的词，与自身词族以及表示拯救和释放的动词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who saves others from danger
able to be saved
not yet saved
to keep someone safe from harm
to release someone from being trapped
to get something back after losing it

normalIntro.en: Rescue pictures a hand reaching into danger and pulling someone out.
normalIntro.cn: rescue 描绘一只手伸进危险，把人拉出来。

normal.en: The re- suggests pulling back, and the old root suggests shaking free.
normal.cn: re- 暗示往回拉，古老词根则暗示抖脱束缚。

normal.en: Rescue workers are the people who go in when others come out.
normal.cn: 救援人员就是别人往外跑时往里冲的人。

normal.en: Come to the rescue is a fixed phrase for offering help.
normal.cn: come to the rescue 是表示「前来帮忙」的固定短语。

normal.en: The noun and the verb look the same: a rescue, to rescue.
normal.cn: 名词和动词同形：a rescue 与 to rescue。

normal.en: Compare save: save is wider, while rescue usually means danger is present.
normal.cn: 对比 save：save 范围更广，rescue 通常意味着危险就在眼前。

abstract.en: Picture a rope thrown across dark water.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳子被抛过漆黑的水面。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand gripping a wrist just before the current pulls.
abstract.cn: 想象在水流卷走前，一只手紧紧抓住手腕。

abstract.en: Think of a lighthouse beam finding a small boat.
abstract.cn: 想象灯塔的光束找到一条小船。

examples.en: Firefighters rescued two people from the burning house.
examples.cn: 消防员从燃烧的房子里救出两个人。

examples.en: A last-minute goal rescued the team from defeat.
examples.cn: 最后时刻的一个进球把球队从失败中挽救回来。

examples.en: The rescue took place at dawn.
examples.cn: 营救行动在黎明时展开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来救」——有危险时有人来救，就是 rescue；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 quatere（摇动）→ excutere（抖出）→ 古法语 escourre（抖脱）→ rescourre（解救）→ 中古英语 rescuen → 现代英语 rescue。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with physical pulling out of danger, extends to rescue from failure, and also names the whole operation.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从把身体从危险中拉出开始，扩展到从失败中挽救，也可指整个营救行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching into danger and pulling someone to safety.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸进危险，把人拉到安全处。

branches.en: Saving from physical danger is the core sense.
branches.cn: 从身体危险中救人，是核心义项。

branches.en: Saving from failure applies the pull to reputation or chances.
branches.cn: 从失败中挽救，把「拉」用于声誉或机会。

branches.en: The noun names the whole saving operation.
branches.cn: 名词指整个营救行动。

branches.en: Physical and figurative rescues both end in relief.
branches.cn: 身体与比喻意义上的营救都以松一口气结束。

branches.en: The act and the operation are described by the same word.
branches.cn: 救助行为与救援行动用同一个词描述。

intro.en: Rescue is a French verb built on a Latin root for shaking, with English endings forming its small family.
intro.cn: rescue 是建立在拉丁语「摇动」词根上的法语动词，小词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin quatere means to shake, and excutere means to shake out or drive off.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quatere 意为摇动，excutere 意为抖出或赶走。

items.exampleCN: re- 增添「往回拉」的意思。

items.example: Excutere gives the idea of shaking free.
Escourre carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: escourre 把这个动词带入法语。

items.example: Rescourre is the direct source of rescue.
items.exampleCN: rescourre 是 rescue 的直接来源。

definition_en: careful study to discover new facts or reach a better understanding
core_image: 一个人把旧资料摊满桌子，一遍遍查找线索
scene: 为了写这篇论文，她花了半年时间查阅地方档案。She spent six months in local archives to research the history of the town.
sceneCN: 这里 research 是「研究」（第 1 个义项：为发现事实而仔细查考）；句意：为了研究这座小镇的历史，她在地方档案馆待了半年。

senses.title: Systematic study of a subject
senses.definition: careful and organized study aimed at discovering facts
senses.definitionCN: 为发现事实而进行的细致、有条理的研究
senses.example: Recent research links sleep to memory.
senses.exampleCN: 最近的研究把睡眠与记忆联系起来。
senses.why: The noun names the whole activity of searching a subject again and again.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指对某个主题反复搜寻的整个活动。

senses.title: To study a subject carefully
senses.definition: to study something in detail in order to understand it
senses.definitionCN: 为理解某事物而详细研究
senses.example: She researched the history of the town for six months.
senses.exampleCN: 她研究这座小镇的历史研究了半年。
senses.why: The verb is the same repeated searching directed at a question.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是把同样的反复搜寻指向一个问题。

senses.title: Published findings
senses.definition: the results or body of work produced by study
senses.definitionCN: 研究产生的结果或成果集合
senses.example: His research on bees was published last year.
senses.exampleCN: 他关于蜜蜂的研究去年发表了。
senses.why: The activity is often named by its output, especially in academic writing.
senses.whyCN: 这项活动常以成果来指代，在学术写作中尤其如此。

intro.en: Research comes from Old French recerche, a search, from recercher, to seek out, built on re- and cerchier, to search.
intro.cn: research 来自古法语 recerche（搜寻），源于 recercher（找出），由 re- 与 cerchier（搜索）构成。

items.en: Circare means to go around or search through.
items.cn: circare 意为绕行、四处搜寻。

items.en: Cerchier means to search.
items.cn: cerchier 意为搜寻。

items.en: Recercher means to seek out thoroughly.
items.cn: recercher 意为彻底找出。

items.en: Recerche means a search or inquiry.
items.cn: recerche 意为搜寻、探究。

items.en: Middle English researchen means to investigate.
items.cn: 中古英语 researchen 意为调查、探究。

items.en: Modern English uses research for academic and scientific study.
items.cn: 现代英语中，research 用于学术与科学研究。

note.en: Research is a searching word, and it sits near its family and near words for study and inquiry.
note.cn: research 是一个「搜寻」词，与自身词族以及表示学习和探究的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who does research
third person form of the verb
entries.definitionCN: 动词第三人称单数形式

entries.definition: past form of the verb
the activity of learning about a subject
a careful examination of facts
a question or formal investigation

normalIntro.en: Research is re- plus search: to search again and again until the answer appears.
normalIntro.cn: research 是 re- 加 search：一遍又一遍地搜寻，直到答案出现。

normal.en: Re- means again, and search means look for.
normal.cn: re- 表示再一次，search 表示寻找。

normal.en: Do research is the common phrase built on the noun.
normal.cn: do research 是由名词构成的常用短语。

normal.en: Research into a subject means looking closely at it.
normal.cn: research into a subject 意为仔细考察某个主题。

normal.en: A researcher is the person who does the searching.
normal.cn: researcher 就是做搜寻工作的人。

normal.en: Compare study: study can be quiet learning, while research aims at new facts.
normal.cn: 对比 study：study 可以是安静学习，research 则旨在发现新事实。

abstract.en: Picture a table covered with open books and marked pages.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上摊满打开的书和做了标记的纸页。

abstract.en: Imagine a scientist repeating a test to be sure.
abstract.cn: 想象科学家为求确定而重复一次实验。

abstract.en: Think of a single question followed through many files.
abstract.cn: 想象一个问题被追进一摞摞档案。

examples.en: She researched the history of the town for six months.
examples.cn: 她研究这座小镇的历史研究了半年。

examples.en: Recent research links sleep to memory.
examples.cn: 最近的研究把睡眠与记忆联系起来。

examples.en: The team is doing research into clean energy.
examples.cn: 团队正在研究清洁能源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + search」——一遍又一遍地搜寻，就是研究；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 circare（四处搜寻）→ 古法语 cerchier（搜索）→ recercher（找出）→ recerche（探究）→ 中古英语 researchen → 现代英语 research。

sensesIntro.en: The word is a repeated search: first the activity, then the verb of studying, then the published results of that study.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词就是「反复搜寻」：先指活动，再指研究的动词，最后指研究发表的成果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a question pursued through piles of evidence.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个问题被追过成堆的证据。

branches.en: Organized study is the main noun sense.
branches.cn: 有条理的研究，是主要名词义项。

branches.en: The verb names the act of searching a subject.
branches.cn: 动词指研究某个主题的行为。

branches.en: Published findings are the visible product of research.
branches.cn: 发表成果是研究可见的产物。

branches.en: The activity and the act are two views of one effort.
branches.cn: 活动与行为是同一种努力的两个视角。

branches.en: Searching produces findings, and findings invite more searching.
branches.cn: 搜寻产生成果，成果又引来更多搜寻。

intro.en: Research is a French-shaped word built on a Latin root for searching, with English endings forming its small family.
intro.cn: research 是建立在拉丁语「搜寻」词根上的法语形态词，小词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin circare means to go around or search, and French cerchier continues that sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circare 意为绕行、搜寻，法语 cerchier 延续这一含义。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of repeating.
Cerchier carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: cerchier 把这个动词带入法语。

items.example: Recerche is the direct source of research.
items.exampleCN: recerche 是 research 的直接来源。

definition_en: to look or seem like someone or something else
core_image: 两个人站在一起，侧脸轮廓几乎重叠
scene: 这对双胞胎长得太像，连老师都会认错。The twins resemble each other so closely that even their teacher mixes them up.
sceneCN: 这里 resemble 是「像」（第 1 个义项：在外貌或性质上相似）；句意：这对双胞胎长得太像，连老师都会认错。

senses.title: To look like someone
senses.definition: to have a similar appearance to another person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 外貌与另一个人或物相似
senses.example: She closely resembles her mother.
senses.exampleCN: 她长得很像她母亲。
senses.why: The Latin root means like, so the verb starts with visible likeness.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「像」，所以这个动词从看得见的外貌相似开始。

senses.title: To have similar qualities
senses.definition: to share features or qualities with something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物共享特征或性质
senses.example: Their styles resemble each other in many ways.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的风格在许多方面彼此相似。
senses.why: Likeness moves from faces to abstract patterns and styles.
senses.whyCN: 相似从面容扩展到抽象的模式与风格。

senses.title: To seem like something
senses.definition: to give the impression of being something, often in formal description
senses.definitionCN: 给人某种印象，常用于正式描写
senses.example: The room resembled a small museum.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间看起来像一座小博物馆。
senses.why: The verb can describe an overall impression, not only a physical match.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词可描述整体印象，而不只是外形吻合。

intro.en: Resemble comes from Old French resembler, from re- and sembler, to seem, ultimately from Latin similis, like.
intro.cn: resemble 来自古法语 resembler，由 re- 与 sembler（显得）构成，最终源于拉丁语 similis（像）。

items.en: Similis means like or similar.
items.cn: similis 意为相像、相似。

items.en: Similare means to make like.
items.cn: similare 意为使相像。

items.en: Sembler means to seem or appear.
items.cn: sembler 意为显得、看起来。

items.en: Resembler means to be like or resemble.
items.cn: resembler 意为相像、类似。

items.en: Middle English resemblen keeps the visual sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 resemblen 保留视觉上的相似。

items.en: Modern English extends resemble to styles, sounds, and situations.
items.cn: 现代英语把 resemble 扩展到风格、声音与情境。

note.en: Resemble is a likeness verb, and it sits near its family and near phrases for looking like.
note.cn: resemble 是一个「相似」动词，与自身词族以及表示「像」的短语相邻。

entries.definition: the state of being similar
similar to something
to bring people or parts together
to have a similar appearance
to look or behave like an older relative
to reflect or match something closely

normalIntro.en: Resemble contains the old root similis, like: to resemble is to be like.
normalIntro.cn: resemble 含有古老词根 similis（像）：相像就是「像」。

normal.en: The re- adds the sense of looking back and seeing the same shape.
normal.cn: re- 增添「回头一看还是同一个轮廓」的感觉。

normal.en: Resemble each other is the most common phrase.
normal.cn: resemble each other 是最常见的短语。

normal.en: Resemblance is the noun for the likeness.
normal.cn: resemblance 是表示「相似」的名词。

normal.en: We resemble family members in looks or manner.
normal.cn: 我们在外貌或举止上像家人。

normal.en: Compare look like: resemble is more formal and uses a single verb.
normal.cn: 对比 look like：resemble 更正式，而且只用一个动词。

abstract.en: Picture two shadows falling at the same angle.
abstract.cn: 想象两道影子以同样的角度落下。

abstract.en: Imagine a face in a photograph echoing another face.
abstract.cn: 想象照片中的一张脸与另一张脸遥相呼应。

abstract.en: Think of two melodies that share the same opening notes.
abstract.cn: 想象两段旋律以相同的开头几个音起句。

examples.en: She closely resembles her mother.
examples.cn: 她长得很像她母亲。

examples.en: Their styles resemble each other in many ways.
examples.cn: 他们的风格在许多方面彼此相似。

examples.en: The room resembled a small museum.
examples.cn: 这个房间看起来像一座小博物馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + semble」——一再看到同样的样子，就是相像；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 similis（像）→ 俗拉丁语 similare（使相像）→ 古法语 sembler（显得）→ resembler（相像）→ 中古英语 resemblen → 现代英语 resemble。

sensesIntro.en: The verb begins with faces, extends to qualities and styles, and finally to the overall impression something gives.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从面容开始，扩展到性质与风格，最后指某物给人的整体印象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two outlines laid over each other until they nearly match.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个轮廓叠在一起，几乎重合。

branches.en: Physical likeness is the oldest and clearest sense.
branches.cn: 外貌相似，是最古老、最清楚的义项。

branches.en: Shared qualities extend likeness beyond appearance.
branches.cn: 共同性质把相似扩展到外貌之外。

branches.en: An overall impression can resemble something else.
branches.cn: 整体印象也可以像另一事物。

branches.en: People can look alike and behave alike at once.
branches.cn: 人可以同时长得像、举止也像。

branches.en: Shared qualities often create the impression of a match.
branches.cn: 共同性质常造成「相互吻合」的印象。

intro.en: Resemble is a French verb built on the Latin root for like, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: resemble 是建立在拉丁语「像」词根上的法语动词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin similis means like, and similare means to make like; French sembler means to seem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 similis 意为像，similare 意为使相像；法语 sembler 意为显得。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of repeated likeness.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「反复相似」的意思。

items.example: Similare turns the adjective into a verb.
items.exampleCN: similare 把形容词变成动词。

items.example: Sembler carries the root into French.

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的词尾

definition_en: an arrangement to keep a seat or room, or a doubt held back
core_image: 桌上放着一张小牌子：此位已留
scene: 她提前一周订了靠窗的位子，准备给母亲过生日。She made a reservation for a window table a week in advance for her mother's birthday.
sceneCN: 这里 reservation 是「预订」（第 1 个义项：预先保留座位或房间）；句意：她提前一周订了靠窗的位子，准备给母亲过生日。

senses.title: An arrangement to keep a place
senses.definition: an arrangement by which a seat, room, or table is kept for you
senses.definitionCN: 为你保留座位、房间或餐桌的安排
senses.example: I made a reservation for two at seven.
senses.exampleCN: 我订了七点两个人的位子。
senses.why: The noun names the result of reserving something in advance.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指预先保留某物的结果。

senses.title: Land kept for a purpose
senses.definition: an area of land kept for a particular use, such as wildlife
senses.definitionCN: 为特定用途保留的一片土地，如野生动物保护
senses.example: The lake lies inside a wildlife reservation.
senses.exampleCN: 这个湖位于一片野生动物保护区内。
senses.why: Keeping something back applies to land as well as to seats.
senses.whyCN: 「保留下来」既适用于座位，也适用于土地。

senses.title: A doubt held back
senses.definition: a doubt or condition that stops you from fully agreeing
senses.definitionCN: 使你无法完全同意的疑虑或条件
senses.example: She agreed to the plan without reservation.
senses.exampleCN: 她毫无保留地同意了这个计划。
senses.why: A reservation is something kept back in the mind rather than spoken at once.
senses.whyCN: 保留意见是留在心里、没有立刻说出的东西。

intro.en: Reservation comes from Latin reservare, to keep back, from re- and servare, to keep.
intro.cn: reservation 来自拉丁语 reservare（保留），由 re- 与 servare（保存）构成。

items.en: Servare means to keep or preserve.
items.cn: servare 意为保存、保全。

items.en: Reservare means to keep back for later.
items.cn: reservare 意为留到以后。

items.en: Reserver means to reserve or hold back.
items.cn: reserver 意为保留、扣下。

items.en: Middle English reserven means to keep something back.
items.cn: 中古英语 reserven 意为把某物留下。

items.en: Reservation appears as a noun for something kept back.
items.cn: 到 14 世纪，reservation 作为名词出现，指被保留之物。

items.en: Modern English adds the senses of booking and protected land.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「预订」与「保留地」两个义项。

note.en: Reservation is the -ation noun of reserve, and it sits near its family and near words for booking and doubt.
note.cn: reservation 是 reserve 的 -ation 名词，与自身词族以及表示预订和疑虑的词相邻。

entries.definition: to keep something for later
kept for later, or quiet and restrained
a member of a military reserve force
an arrangement made in advance
a feeling of not being sure
a condition added to a statement

normalIntro.en: Reservation is reserve plus -ation, so it names the act of keeping something back.
normalIntro.cn: reservation 是 reserve 加 -ation，指把某物保留下来的行为。

normal.en: A table reservation keeps a place for you.
normal.cn: table reservation 为你留住一个位子。

normal.en: Without reservation means with no doubt held back.
normal.cn: without reservation 意为毫无保留。

normal.en: The same noun can mean a protected area kept for a purpose.
normal.cn: 同一个名词也可指为特定目的保留的区域。

normal.en: Reserve is the verb, and reservation is the arrangement.
normal.cn: reserve 是动词，reservation 是安排。

normal.en: Compare booking: booking is the everyday word, while reservation is more formal.
normal.cn: 对比 booking：booking 更日常，reservation 更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a small card on a table saying the seat is held.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上放着一张小卡片，写着位子已留。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand hovering over a question rather than agreeing at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手悬在问题上，没有立刻答应。

abstract.en: Think of a fenced field set aside for animals.
abstract.cn: 想象一片围起来的田地，专门留给动物。

examples.en: I made a reservation for two at seven.
examples.cn: 我订了七点两个人的位子。

examples.en: She agreed to the plan without reservation.
examples.cn: 她毫无保留地同意了这个计划。

examples.en: The hotel lost our reservation.
examples.cn: 酒店把我们的预订弄丢了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + serve」——预先保留下来为客人服务，就是预订；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 servare（保存）→ reservare（保留）→ 古法语 reserver → 中古英语 reserven → reserve ＋ -ation → reservation。

sensesIntro.en: The noun starts as something kept back, then names a booked place, a protected area, and finally a doubt kept back in the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词从「被保留之物」开始，进而指预订的位子、受保护的区域，最后指留在心里的疑虑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place or thing marked as held for someone.
core.cn: 核心意象：某处或某物被标记为「已为某人留住」。

branches.en: A booking is the everyday modern sense.
branches.cn: 预订，是现代日常义项。

branches.en: Protected land is something kept back for a purpose.
branches.cn: 保护区是为特定目的保留的土地。

branches.en: A doubt is something kept back from full agreement.
branches.cn: 保留意见是从完全同意中收回的部分。

branches.en: A seat and a field are both held for future use.
branches.cn: 座位与土地都是留作以后使用。

branches.en: Booking a place and withholding judgment both involve holding back.
branches.cn: 预订位子与保留判断都涉及「留住」。

intro.en: Reservation is an English -ation noun built on the Latin verb reservare.
intro.cn: reservation 是建立在拉丁动词 reservare 上的英语 -ation 名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare means to keep, and reservare means to keep back; French reserver carries the verb onward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 servare 意为保存，reservare 意为保留；法语 reserver 把这个动词继续传递。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of keeping back.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「留在后面」的意思。

items.example: Reservare joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: reservare 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Reserver carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: reserver 把这个动词带入法语。

definition_en: to keep something for future use, or a supply kept in readiness
core_image: 仓库深处留着一批物资，标签上写着「备用」
scene: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水，以备停电时使用。They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage in case the power failed.
sceneCN: 这里 reserve 是「保留」（第 1 个义项：留作以后使用）；句意：他们在车库后面留了几箱水，以备停电时使用。

senses.title: To keep for future use
senses.definition: to keep something so that it can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把某物留存下来，供以后使用
senses.example: They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to keep back, which is the core of every sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为保留，这是所有义项的核心。

senses.title: A supply kept ready
senses.definition: an amount of something kept for use in an emergency or later
senses.definitionCN: 为紧急情况或以后使用而储存的数量
senses.example: The army kept a reserve of fuel.
senses.exampleCN: 军队储备了燃料。
senses.why: The noun names the thing that has been kept back.
senses.whyCN: 名词指被保留下来的东西。

senses.title: Self-restraint
senses.definition: the habit of not showing feelings or thoughts openly
senses.definitionCN: 不轻易外露情感或想法的习惯
senses.example: He spoke with reserve about his own success.
senses.exampleCN: 他谈到自己的成功时很克制。
senses.why: Feelings kept back from view produce the social sense of reserve.
senses.whyCN: 情感被留在视线之外，就产生「矜持」这一社交含义。

intro.en: Reserve comes from Latin reservare, to keep back, from re- and servare, to keep, through Old French reserver.
intro.cn: reserve 来自拉丁语 reservare（保留），由 re- 与 servare（保存）构成，经古法语 reserver 进入英语。

items.en: Servare means to keep or preserve.
items.cn: servare 意为保存、保全。

items.en: Reservare means to keep back for later.
items.cn: reservare 意为留到以后。

items.en: Reserver means to reserve or hold back.
items.cn: reserver 意为保留、扣下。

items.en: Middle English reserven means to keep back.
items.cn: 中古英语 reserven 意为保留。

items.en: Reserve appears as a noun for a supply kept ready.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，reserve 作为名词出现，指备用的储备。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of personal restraint.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「个人克制」这一义项。

note.en: Reserve is a keeping-back word, and it sits near its family and near verbs for keeping and booking.
note.cn: reserve 是一个「留住」词，与自身词族以及表示保存和预订的动词相邻。

a member of a reserve force
to continue to have something
to keep something for future use

normalIntro.en: Reserve is re- plus the Latin root for keep: to keep something back for later.
normalIntro.cn: reserve 是 re- 加拉丁语「保存」词根：把东西留到以后。

normal.en: Reserve a table means keep it for a future time.
normal.cn: reserve a table 意为把桌子留到以后用。

normal.en: A nature reserve is land kept for wildlife.
normal.cn: nature reserve 是为野生动物保留的土地。

normal.en: In reserve means held ready but not yet used.
normal.cn: in reserve 意为留作备用、尚未使用。

normal.en: Reserved can describe a quiet, restrained person.
normal.cn: reserved 可以形容安静、克制的人。

normal.en: Compare keep: keep is general, while reserve stresses setting aside.
normal.cn: 对比 keep：keep 更泛，reserve 强调「单独留出来」。

abstract.en: Picture boxes stacked at the back of a garage.
abstract.cn: 想象车库深处堆着几只箱子。

abstract.en: Imagine a fuel gauge with a hidden lower section.
abstract.cn: 想象油表下面还藏着一段备用油量。

abstract.en: Think of a quiet person holding words back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个安静的人把话留在心里。

examples.en: Please reserve a table for two.
examples.cn: 请订一张两人桌。

examples.en: They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage.
examples.cn: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水。

examples.en: The nature reserve protects rare birds.
examples.cn: 自然保护区保护稀有鸟类。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + serve」——留下来以后再用，就是保留；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 servare（保存）→ reservare（保留）→ 古法语 reserver → 中古英语 reserven → 现代英语 reserve，核心义「留住备用」。

sensesIntro.en: The word keeps one image, holding something back: a thing kept for later, a supply set aside, and feelings kept out of sight.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词始终保留一个意象——把东西留住：留待以后之物、单列出来的储备，以及不外露的情感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a supply set aside with a label saying for later.
core.cn: 核心意象：一批物资被单独放好，标签写着「留待以后」。

branches.en: Keeping something for later is the core verb sense.
branches.cn: 留作后用，是核心动词义项。

branches.en: A reserve is the supply that has been set aside.
branches.cn: 储备就是被单独留出的物资。

branches.en: Reserve of manner is feeling kept back from view.
branches.cn: 举止上的矜持，是情感被留在视线之外。

branches.en: The act of reserving creates the thing held in reserve.
branches.cn: 保留的行为造出了储备之物。

branches.en: A hidden supply and hidden feeling share the same restraint.
branches.cn: 隐藏的物资与隐藏的情感共享同一种克制。

intro.en: Reserve is a Latin verb reshaped by French, and English endings form its modern family.
intro.cn: reserve 是经法语改造的拉丁动词，现代词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare means to keep, and reservare means to keep back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 servare 意为保存，reservare 意为保留。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of keeping back.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「留在后面」的意思。

definition_en: a lake or container for storing water, or a large supply of something
core_image: 山谷被一道坝拦住，雨水在谷底静静积成一片湖
scene: 这座水库供应着下游三个城镇的饮用水。The reservoir supplies drinking water to three towns downstream.
sceneCN: 这里 reservoir 是「水库」（第 1 个义项：蓄水的人工湖）；句意：这座水库为下游三个城镇供应饮用水。

senses.title: An artificial lake for water
senses.definition: a natural or artificial lake used for storing water for a town or region
senses.definitionCN: 为城镇或地区储水而建的自然或人工湖
senses.example: The reservoir supplies drinking water to three towns.
senses.exampleCN: 这座水库为三个城镇供应饮用水。
senses.why: The French noun names a place where something is kept, and water is the first thing stored there.
senses.whyCN: 这个法语名词指储存某物的地方，而水是最先被储存在那里的东西。

senses.title: A large supply of something
senses.definition: a large amount of something available when needed, such as knowledge or talent
senses.definitionCN: 需要时可取用的大量某物，如知识或人才
senses.example: She has a deep reservoir of patience.
senses.exampleCN: 她有很深的耐心储备。
senses.why: Water kept in reserve becomes a metaphor for any resource held in large quantity.
senses.whyCN: 蓄起来的水，成为任何大量储备资源的比喻。

senses.title: A container that holds fluid
senses.definition: a container inside a machine that holds ink, oil, or another fluid
senses.definitionCN: 机器内部盛放墨水、油或其他液体的容器
senses.example: The pen's ink reservoir was empty.
senses.exampleCN: 钢笔的墨盒空了。
senses.why: The same storage image shrinks to a small part inside a tool.
senses.whyCN: 同样的储存意象缩小为工具内部的一个小部件。

intro.en: Reservoir is French réservoir, a place of storage, from réserver, to keep back, ultimately Latin reservare.
intro.cn: reservoir 是法语 réservoir（储存之处），源于 réserver（保留），最终来自拉丁语 reservare。

items.en: Servare means to keep or preserve.
items.cn: servare 意为保存、保全。

items.en: Reservare means to keep back.

items.en: Reserver means to reserve or hold back.
items.cn: reserver 意为保留、扣下。

items.en: Réservoir names a place where something is stored.
items.cn: réservoir 指储存某物的地方。

items.en: English reservoir is used for lakes that store water.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，英语 reservoir 用于蓄水的湖泊。

items.en: Modern English extends reservoir to supplies of knowledge and talent.
items.cn: 现代英语把 reservoir 扩展到知识与人才的储备。

note.en: Reservoir is a storage-place word, and it sits near its family and near words for tanks and supplies.
note.cn: reservoir 是一个「储存处」词，与自身词族以及表示水箱和储备的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Reservoir is the French place form of reserve: a place where water is kept back.
normalIntro.cn: reservoir 是 reserve 的法语「场所」形式：把水留住的地方。

normal.en: The -oir ending in French often names a place or container.
normal.cn: 法语词尾 -oir 常表示场所或容器。

normal.en: A reservoir holds water for a whole town.
normal.cn: 水库为整个城镇蓄水。

normal.en: A reservoir of knowledge is the same image applied to learning.
normal.cn: a reservoir of knowledge 是把同一意象用于学问。

normal.en: An ink reservoir keeps a pen writing.
normal.cn: 墨盒让钢笔能继续书写。

normal.en: Compare tank: a tank is smaller and often closed.
normal.cn: 对比 tank：tank 更小，且常是封闭的。

abstract.en: Picture a valley slowly filling after weeks of rain.
abstract.cn: 想象连下几周雨后，山谷慢慢积满水。

abstract.en: Imagine a dam holding a wall of green water.
abstract.cn: 想象大坝挡住一堵绿色的水墙。

abstract.en: Think of a deep well no one can see the bottom of.
abstract.cn: 想象一口深井，谁也看不到底。

examples.en: The reservoir supplies drinking water to three towns.
examples.cn: 这座水库为三个城镇供应饮用水。

examples.en: She has a deep reservoir of patience.
examples.cn: 她有很深的耐心储备。

examples.en: The pen's ink reservoir was empty.
examples.cn: 钢笔的墨盒空了。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a valley sealed by a dam, holding water in reserve.
core.cn: 核心意象：山谷被大坝封住，把水留在里面。

branches.en: A water lake is the basic physical sense.
branches.cn: 蓄水的湖，是基本物理义项。

branches.en: Any large supply is water turned into metaphor.
branches.cn: 任何大量储备，都是「水」的比喻化。

branches.en: A machine container is the same storage image in miniature.
branches.cn: 机器内的容器，是同一储存意象的缩小版。

branches.en: A reservoir stores for a town, just as knowledge stores for a person.
branches.cn: 水库为城镇储存，知识为人储存。

branches.en: Large supplies and small ink supplies are both held in reserve.
branches.cn: 大量储备与小墨盒都是「留着备用」。

definition_en: to live in a particular place, or to exist in something
core_image: 一栋房子门口钉着姓名牌，人长期住在里面
scene: 他在这条街住了二十年，却很少和邻居来往。He has resided on this street for twenty years but rarely speaks to his neighbours.
sceneCN: 这里 reside 是「居住」（第 1 个义项：长期住在某处）；句意：他在这条街住了二十年，却很少和邻居来往。

senses.title: To live in a place
senses.definition: to live in a particular place for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 长期住在某个地方
senses.example: He has resided on this street for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在这条街住了二十年。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to remain behind, which becomes settling and living somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「留在后面」，由此变成定居与居住。

senses.title: To exist in something
senses.definition: to be present as a quality or power in something
senses.definitionCN: 作为性质或力量存在于某物之中
senses.example: The value of the plan resides in its simplicity.
senses.exampleCN: 这项计划的价值在于它的简洁。
senses.why: A quality can be pictured as living inside the thing that shows it.
senses.whyCN: 一种性质可以被想象成住在展现它的那个事物里面。

senses.title: To be vested in someone
senses.definition: to belong to a person or body as a right or power
senses.definitionCN: 作为权利或权力归属于某人或机构
senses.example: Supreme power resides with the people.
senses.exampleCN: 最高权力属于人民。
senses.why: Power is thought of as dwelling in the body that holds it.
senses.whyCN: 权力被看作居住在掌握它的机构之中。

intro.en: Reside comes from Latin residere, to remain behind or settle, from re- and sedere, to sit.
intro.cn: reside 来自拉丁语 residere（留下、定居），由 re- 与 sedere（坐）构成。

items.en: Sedere means to sit.
items.cn: sedere 意为坐。

items.en: Residere means to remain behind or settle.
items.cn: residere 意为留在后面、定居。

items.en: Resider means to stay or dwell.
items.cn: resider 意为停留、居住。

items.en: Middle English residen means to dwell in a place.
items.cn: 中古英语 residen 意为在某地居住。

items.en: Reside is used for a person's fixed home.
items.cn: 到 15 世纪，reside 用于指人的固定住所。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of a quality residing in something.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「性质存在于某物中」的义项。

note.en: Reside is a settling verb, and it sits near its noun family and near verbs for living and staying.
note.cn: reside 是一个「定居」动词，与名词词族以及表示居住和停留的动词相邻。

normal.en: Re- suggests staying in place, and sedere means sit.
normal.cn: re- 暗示留在原处，sedere 表示坐。

normal.en: Reside in a place is a formal way to say live there.
normal.cn: reside in a place 是「住在那里」的正式说法。

normal.en: The power to decide resides with the committee.
normal.cn: 决定权属于委员会。

normal.en: Residence and resident both grow from this verb.
normal.cn: residence 与 resident 都从这个动词生长出来。

normal.en: Compare live: live is everyday, while reside is formal.
normal.cn: 对比 live：live 是日常用语，reside 更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a nameplate fixed beside a door for years.
abstract.cn: 想象门边挂着一块多年的姓名牌。

abstract.en: Imagine roots spreading under a house.
abstract.cn: 想象树根在一座房子下面延伸。

abstract.en: Think of a thought living quietly inside a plan.
abstract.cn: 想象一个想法安静地住在一项计划里。

examples.en: He has resided on this street for twenty years.
examples.cn: 他在这条街住了二十年。

examples.en: The value of the plan resides in its simplicity.
examples.cn: 这项计划的价值在于它的简洁。

examples.en: Supreme power resides with the people.
examples.cn: 最高权力属于人民。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + side」——一直待在这一边住下，就是居住；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sedere（坐）→ residere（留下、定居）→ 古法语 resider → 中古英语 residen → 现代英语 reside。

sensesIntro.en: The verb begins with the image of sitting down and staying, then extends to qualities that live inside things and powers that belong to a body.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从「坐下并留下」的画面开始，再扩展到「住在事物内部」的性质，以及「归属于某机构」的权力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person settled in one house and staying there.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人在一栋房子里安顿下来并长住。

branches.en: Living in a place is the core physical sense.
branches.cn: 在某地居住，是核心物理义项。

branches.en: A quality lives inside what shows it.
branches.cn: 性质住在展现它的东西里面。

branches.en: Power belongs to the body that holds it.
branches.cn: 权力归属于掌握它的机构。

branches.en: A person resides in a house, and a value resides in a plan.
branches.cn: 人住在房子里，价值住在计划里。

branches.en: Both qualities and powers are pictured as dwelling somewhere.
branches.cn: 性质与权力都被想象成「住在某处」。

intro.en: Reside is a Latin verb carried through French, with English endings forming its noun and adjective family.
intro.cn: reside 是经法语传递的拉丁动词，名词与形容词词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin sedere means to sit, and residere means to remain behind or settle.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sedere 意为坐，residere 意为留下、定居。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of remaining.
Residere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: residere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.exampleCN: resider 把这个动词带入法语。

definition_en: the place where someone lives, or the fact of living there
core_image: 一扇亮着灯的窗，窗后是某人固定的家
scene: 总统官邸位于河岸边，四周有高高的围栏。The president's residence stands by the river, surrounded by high fences.
sceneCN: 这里 residence 是「官邸；住宅」（第 1 个义项：某人居住的地方）；句意：总统官邸位于河岸边，四周有高高的围栏。

senses.title: The place where someone lives
senses.definition: the house or place in which a person lives
senses.definitionCN: 一个人居住的房子或地方
senses.example: The president's residence stands by the river.
senses.exampleCN: 总统官邸位于河岸边。
senses.why: The noun names the place produced by residing.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指居住这一行为所产生的场所。

senses.title: The act or period of living somewhere
senses.definition: the fact of living in a place, often used in official language
senses.definitionCN: 在某地居住的事实，常用于官方语言
senses.example: She took up residence in Paris last year.
senses.exampleCN: 她去年开始在巴黎居住。
senses.why: Residence can name the state of living there, not only the building.
senses.whyCN: residence 可指居住状态，而不只是建筑。

senses.title: A large impressive house
senses.definition: a large and formal house, especially an official one
senses.definitionCN: 大型而正式的住宅，尤指官邸
senses.example: The family moved to a smaller residence.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人搬进了一处较小的宅邸。
senses.why: The formal word for a home often suggests size and dignity.
senses.whyCN: 「住所」的正式说法常带有规模与体面的意味。

intro.en: Residence comes from Latin residentia, a staying behind, from residere, to remain, through Old French residence.
intro.cn: residence 来自拉丁语 residentia（停留），源于 residere（留下），经古法语 residence 进入英语。

items.cn: sedere 意为坐。

items.en: Residere means to remain behind or dwell.
items.cn: residere 意为留下、居住。

items.en: Residentia means a staying behind or a dwelling.

items.en: Residence means a place of dwelling.

items.en: English residence names both the act and the place of living.

items.en: Modern English uses residence for homes, permits, and official dwellings.
items.cn: 现代英语中，residence 用于住宅、居留许可与官邸。

note.en: Residence is the noun of residing, and it sits near its family and near words for home and dwelling.
note.cn: residence 是 reside 的名词，与自身词族以及表示家和住所的词相邻。

abstract.en: Think of a door key kept for many years.

branches.en: The act of living there appears in official phrases.

branches.en: A grand house adds dignity to the same word.

branches.en: The building and the fact of living there depend on each other.

branches.en: Official residence joins the legal and the grand senses.

scene: 每到周末，这条街的居民会把旧家具搬到人行道上出售。Every weekend, the residents of this street put old furniture out on the pavement to sell.
sceneCN: 这里 resident 是「居民」（第 1 个义项：在某地居住的人）；句意：每到周末，这条街的居民会把旧家具搬到人行道上出售。

senses.title: A person who lives in a place
senses.definition: someone who lives in a particular house, street, or town
senses.definitionCN: 住在某栋房子、某条街或某个城镇的人
senses.example: The residents of the street meet every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这条街的居民每年春天聚会。
senses.why: The -ent ending names the person who carries out the action of residing.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -ent 指执行「居住」这一动作的人。

senses.title: A doctor in hospital training
senses.definition: a doctor who has finished medical school and is training in a hospital
senses.definitionCN: 医学院毕业后在医院接受培训的医生
senses.example: She is a resident doctor at the city hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 她是市医院的住院医生。
senses.why: The doctor lives at the hospital during training, so the residing word fits the role.
senses.whyCN: 这类医生在培训期间住在医院，因此「居住」这个词也适用于这一身份。

senses.title: Living in a place
senses.definition: living permanently in a particular place, used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 长期住在某处，用于名词前
senses.example: A resident cat sleeps by the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 一只常驻的猫睡在炉火旁。
senses.why: The adjective describes whatever stays in place rather than visiting.
senses.whyCN: 形容词描述长期待在那里而非临时来访的人或动物。

senses.title: Consisting of homes

senses.whyCN: -ial 形容词描述以居住为目的的区域。

senses.title: Involving living on site
senses.definition: connected with living in a place while studying or receiving care
senses.definitionCN: 与在学习或接受照护期间住在某处有关
senses.example: The college offers residential courses in summer.

senses.title: Used for housing

senses.why: Any building can be classified by whether it is meant for living in.

definition_en: to officially leave a job, or to accept something you cannot change
core_image: 一个人把办公室钥匙放在桌上，签下最后一笔
scene: 董事会改组后，财务总监当天就递交了辞呈。After the board was reshuffled, the finance director resigned that same day.
sceneCN: 这里 resign 是「辞职」（第 1 个义项：正式离开职位）；句意：董事会改组后，财务总监当天就辞职了。

senses.title: To leave a job officially
senses.definition: to state formally that you are leaving your job or position
senses.definitionCN: 正式声明将要离开工作或职位
senses.example: The finance director resigned that same day.
senses.exampleCN: 财务总监当天就辞职了。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to unseal or give back, and giving back a post is the modern core.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为开封交回，而把职位交回就是现代核心义。

senses.title: To give up a right or claim
senses.definition: to surrender a right, claim, or possession formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式让出权利、主张或所有物
senses.example: She resigned her claim to the property.
senses.exampleCN: 她放弃了对这处房产的继承主张。
senses.why: What is given back can be a right as well as a job.
senses.whyCN: 交回的既可以是职位，也可以是权利。

senses.title: To accept what cannot be changed
senses.definition: to accept an unpleasant situation because it cannot be avoided
senses.definitionCN: 因无法避免而接受不愉快的处境
senses.example: He resigned himself to another long wait.

sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词涵盖社会对抗、物理与电阻的阻滞，以及生物抵御侵害的能力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two forces locked against each other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两股力量互相顶住。

branches.en: Social and political opposition is the main sense.
branches.cn: 社会与政治对抗，是主要义项。

branches.en: Physical drag and electrical resistance are measurable forces.
branches.cn: 物理阻力与电阻是可测量的力。

branches.en: Biological resistance keeps a living thing unharmed.
branches.cn: 生物抵抗力使生物免受伤害。

branches.en: People and materials both push back against pressure.
branches.cn: 人与材料都会顶回压力。

branches.en: Friction and immunity both slow or block harm.
branches.cn: 摩擦与免疫都减缓或阻挡伤害。

intro.en: Resistance is an English -ance noun built on the Latin verb resistere.
intro.cn: resistance 是建立在拉丁动词 resistere 上的英语 -ance 名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sistere means to take a stand, and resistere means to stand against.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sistere 意为站定，resistere 意为站到对面。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of pushing back.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「顶回去」的意思。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或动作的词尾

definition_zh: 抵抗的；有抵抗力的；耐……的
definition_en: not easily harmed or affected by something, or opposing something
core_image: 一层看不见的铠甲，把水、火或细菌挡在外面
scene: 这种布经过处理，不容易被水浸湿。This cloth is treated to be resistant to water.
sceneCN: 这里 resistant 是「耐……的」（第 1 个义项：不容易受到某物影响或伤害）；句意：这种布经过处理，能防水。

pos.zh: 抵抗的；有抵抗力的；耐……的

senses.title: Not easily harmed by something
senses.definition: strong enough to remain undamaged or unaffected by a substance or condition
senses.definitionCN: 足够坚固，面对某种物质或条件仍不受损、不受影响
senses.example: This cloth is treated to be resistant to water.
senses.exampleCN: 这种布经过处理，能防水。
senses.why: The -ant adjective describes the quality shown by something that resists.
senses.whyCN: -ant 形容词描述某物抵抗时所展现的性质。

senses.title: Opposing change or control
senses.definition: unwilling to accept a change, idea, or authority
senses.definitionCN: 不愿接受变化、观念或权威
senses.example: The committee was resistant to change.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会抗拒变革。
senses.why: The same standing-against quality appears in human attitudes.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「顶住」性质出现在人的态度中。

senses.title: Able to withstand a drug
senses.definition: used of germs that are no longer harmed by a medicine
senses.definitionCN: 用于指不再被药物伤害的病菌
senses.example: Drug-resistant bacteria are a growing concern.
senses.exampleCN: 耐药细菌日益令人担忧。
senses.why: A germ that stands against medicine is resistant in the medical sense.
senses.whyCN: 顶住药物的病菌，就是医学意义上的「耐药」。

intro.en: Resistant is the present participle of Latin resistere, to stand against, used as an English adjective.
intro.cn: resistant 是拉丁语 resistere（站到对面）的现在分词，在英语中作形容词。

items.en: Sistere means to take a stand.
items.cn: sistere 意为站定。

items.en: Resistere means to stand against.
items.cn: resistere 意为站到对面。

items.en: Resister means to resist.
items.cn: resister 意为抵抗。

items.en: Resist settles into English as the base verb.
items.cn: resist 作为基础动词进入英语。

items.en: Resistant appears as an adjective of quality.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，resistant 作为性质形容词出现。

items.en: Modern English uses resistant for water, heat, drugs, and change.
items.cn: 现代英语中，resistant 用于水、热、药物与变化。

note.en: Resistant is the adjective of resist, and it sits near its family and near words for immunity and toughness.
note.cn: resistant 是 resist 的形容词，与自身词族以及表示免疫和坚韧的词相邻。

entries.definition: to fight against something
the act of resisting or a force against motion
a device that limits current
protected from a disease or effect
strong and not easily damaged
strongly against something

normalIntro.en: Resistant is resist plus -ant: showing the quality of standing against something.
normalIntro.cn: resistant 是 resist 加 -ant：表现出顶住某物的性质。

normal.en: Resistant to is the fixed pattern.
normal.cn: resistant to 是固定搭配。

normal.en: Water-resistant cloth keeps rain out for a while.
normal.cn: 防水布能暂时挡住雨水。

normal.en: Heat-resistant materials survive high temperatures.
normal.cn: 耐热材料能承受高温。

normal.en: People can be resistant to change.
normal.cn: 人可能抗拒变化。

normal.en: Compare immune: immune means fully protected, while resistant means able to withstand.
normal.cn: 对比 immune：immune 指完全免疫，resistant 指能够抵挡。

abstract.en: Picture an invisible coat shedding drops of water.
abstract.cn: 想象一件看不见的外衣让水珠滑落。

abstract.en: Imagine a shield taking a blow without cracking.
abstract.cn: 想象盾牌受击却不裂开。

abstract.en: Think of weeds pushing back through pavement.
abstract.cn: 想象杂草从路面缝隙里顶出来。

examples.en: This cloth is treated to be resistant to water.
examples.cn: 这种布经过处理，能防水。

examples.en: The committee was resistant to change.
examples.cn: 委员会抗拒变革。

examples.en: Drug-resistant bacteria are a growing concern.
examples.cn: 耐药细菌日益令人担忧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「resist + ant」——身上带着顶住的劲儿，就是有抵抗力的；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sistere（站定）→ resistere（站到对面）→ 古法语 resister → 英语 resist ＋ -ant → resistant。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective describes whatever can stand against harm: a fabric against water, a person against change, a germ against medicine.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词描述能顶住伤害的事物：布料防水、人抗拒变化、病菌耐药。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an invisible armour that keeps a threat outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层看不见的铠甲，把威胁挡在外面。

branches.en: Materials that withstand water or heat are the basic sense.
branches.cn: 防水耐热的材料，是基本义项。

branches.en: People who oppose change show the same quality.
branches.cn: 抗拒变化的人表现出同样的性质。

branches.en: Germs that survive medicine are resistant in the medical sense.
branches.cn: 在药物下存活的病菌，是医学意义上的耐药。

branches.en: Cloth and bacteria both keep a harmful substance out.
branches.cn: 布料与细菌都把有害物质挡在外面。

branches.en: An attitude and a germ can both refuse to give way.
branches.cn: 态度与病菌都可以拒绝让步。

intro.en: Resistant is an English -ant adjective built on the Latin verb resistere.
intro.cn: resistant 是建立在拉丁动词 resistere 上的英语 -ant 形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sistere means to take a stand, and resistere means to stand against.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sistere 意为站定，resistere 意为站到对面。

items.exampleCN: re- 增添「顶回去」的意思。

definition_en: a firm decision, a formal vote, the solving of a problem, or image sharpness
core_image: 一个人把复杂纠缠的线团一点点解开，最后拉直
scene: 新年第一天，她下定决心每天早起读书。On the first day of the new year, she made a resolution to read every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 resolution 是「决心」（第 1 个义项：坚定的决定）；句意：新年第一天，她下定决心每天早起读书。

senses.title: A firm personal decision
senses.definition: a serious decision to do or stop doing something
senses.definitionCN: 认真决定去做或停止做某事
senses.example: She made a resolution to read every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她下定决心每天早晨读书。
senses.why: The word names the mind settling on a course, like a knot finally pulled straight.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指心思终于定下方向，就像绳结最终被拉直。

senses.title: A formal decision by vote
senses.definition: a formal statement or decision agreed by a group or council
senses.definitionCN: 由团体或委员会表决同意的正式声明或决定
senses.example: The council passed a resolution against the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会通过了一项反对该计划的决议。
senses.why: A group can settle its will as firmly as a person does.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体也能像个人一样坚定地定下意志。

senses.title: The solving of a problem
senses.definition: the act of finding an answer to a difficulty or dispute
senses.definitionCN: 为困难或争端找到答案的行为
senses.example: The resolution of the dispute took months.
senses.exampleCN: 这场争端的解决花了几个月。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to loosen, and solving a problem is loosening it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为松开，而解决问题就是把问题松开。

senses.title: Image sharpness
senses.definition: the amount of detail a screen, image, or lens can show
senses.definitionCN: 屏幕、图像或镜头能显示的细节数量
senses.example: The photograph has very high resolution.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片的分辨率很高。
senses.why: A high-resolution image can be resolved, or separated, into fine points of detail.
senses.whyCN: 高分辨率图像能被「解析」成细小的细节点。

intro.en: Resolution comes from Latin resolutio, a loosening, from resolvere, to loosen completely, built on re- and solvere.
intro.cn: resolution 来自拉丁语 resolutio（松开），源于 resolvere（彻底解开），由 re- 与 solvere 构成。

items.en: Solvere means to loosen, release, or pay.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、释放或偿付。

items.en: Resolvere means to loosen completely or dissolve.
items.cn: resolvere 意为彻底解开或溶解。

items.en: Resolutio means a loosening or a settling.
items.cn: resolutio 意为松开、定解。

items.en: Resolution keeps the sense of a firm settling.
items.cn: resolution 保留「坚定定下」的含义。

items.en: Middle English resolution covers decisions and solutions.
items.cn: 中古英语 resolution 兼指决定与解决。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of screen and image sharpness.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了屏幕与图像分辨率的义项。

note.en: Resolution is the noun of resolve, and it sits near its family and near words for decision and solution.
note.cn: resolution 是 resolve 的名词，与自身词族以及表示决定和解决的词相邻。

entries.definition: to solve a problem or decide firmly
firmly decided
firm and determined
a choice that has been made
an answer to a problem
firmness of purpose

normalIntro.en: Resolution is resolve plus -ion: the act of loosening a problem or fixing a decision.
normalIntro.cn: resolution 是 resolve 加 -ion：解开问题或定下决心的行为。

normal.en: Re- means back, and solvere means loosen.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，solvere 表示松开。

normal.en: A New Year's resolution is a promise to yourself.
normal.cn: New Year's resolution 是对自己的承诺。

normal.en: A council resolution is a formal vote.
normal.cn: council resolution 是正式表决。

normal.en: The resolution of a problem is its solution.
normal.cn: 问题的 resolution 就是它的解决办法。

normal.en: High resolution means the image can be resolved into fine detail.
normal.cn: 高分辨率意味着图像能被解析出细腻细节。

abstract.en: Picture a tangled cord straightened strand by strand.
abstract.cn: 想象一团乱绳被一缕缕理直。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand pressing a stamp on a formal paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在正式文件上盖章。

abstract.en: Think of a blurred photo sharpening into clear faces.
abstract.cn: 想象一张模糊照片渐渐显出清晰的面孔。

examples.en: She made a resolution to read every morning.
examples.cn: 她下定决心每天早晨读书。

examples.en: The council passed a resolution against the plan.
examples.cn: 委员会通过了一项反对该计划的决议。

examples.en: The resolution of the dispute took months.
examples.cn: 这场争端的解决花了几个月。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「resolve + ion」——把问题解开、把决心定下，就是 resolution；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 solvere（松开）→ resolvere（彻底解开）→ resolutio（松开、定解）→ 古法语 resolution → 现代英语 resolution。

sensesIntro.en: The noun moves from loosening a problem to settling a decision, then to a formal group vote, and finally to an image resolved into fine detail.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词从「解开问题」到「定下决定」，再到群体正式表决，最后指图像被解析出的清晰细节。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tangled problem loosened until it lies straight.
core.cn: 核心意象：纠缠的问题被解开，直到平直。

branches.en: A personal decision is the mind settling on one course.
branches.cn: 个人决心，是心思定在一条路上。

branches.en: A formal vote settles a group's will.
branches.cn: 正式表决定下群体的意志。

branches.en: Solving a problem loosens its difficulties.
branches.cn: 解决问题就是把难处解开。

branches.en: Image sharpness separates a picture into fine points.
branches.cn: 图像分辨率把画面分成细小的点。

branches.en: Both a solution and a sharp image depend on separating detail clearly.
branches.cn: 解决办法与清晰图像都依赖把细节分清楚。

intro.en: Resolution is an English -ion noun built on the Latin verb resolvere.
intro.cn: resolution 是建立在拉丁动词 resolvere 上的英语 -ion 名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere means to loosen, and resolvere means to loosen completely.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 solvere 意为松开，resolvere 意为彻底解开。

items.exampleCN: re- 增添「往回松开」的意思。

definition_en: to solve a problem, or to decide firmly to do something
core_image: 把一团乱麻一根根解开，直到线变得笔直
scene: 两家人坐下来谈了一个下午，终于把多年的地界纠纷解决了。The two families sat down for an afternoon and finally resolved their long dispute over the boundary.
sceneCN: 这里 resolve 是「解决」（第 1 个义项：把问题处理掉）；句意：两家人坐了一个下午，终于解决了多年的地界纠纷。

senses.title: To solve a problem or end a dispute
senses.definition: to find an answer to a problem or bring a disagreement to an end
senses.definitionCN: 为问题找到答案，或结束分歧
senses.example: The two families resolved their dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 两家人解决了他们的争端。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to loosen, and a solved problem is a loosened knot.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为松开，被解决的问题就是被解开的结。

senses.title: To decide firmly
senses.definition: to make a firm decision to do something
senses.definitionCN: 坚定决定去做某事
senses.example: She resolved to speak to him that evening.
senses.exampleCN: 她决心那天晚上和他谈一谈。
senses.why: A mind that stops wavering has settled, or resolved itself, on one course.
senses.whyCN: 不再摇摆的心思就「定」在了一条路上。

senses.title: To separate into parts
senses.definition: to break down or change into separate parts, used in technical description
senses.definitionCN: 分解或转变为不同部分，用于技术描写
senses.example: The mixture resolved into two clear layers.
senses.exampleCN: 混合物分成了两层清澈的液体。
senses.why: Loosening can mean a whole separating into its components.
senses.whyCN: 「松开」也可以指整体分开成各个组成部分。

intro.en: Resolve comes from Latin resolvere, to loosen completely, from re- and solvere, to loosen.
intro.cn: resolve 来自拉丁语 resolvere（彻底解开），由 re- 与 solvere（松开）构成。

items.en: Solvere means to loosen or release.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、释放。

items.en: Resolvere means to loosen completely or dissolve.
items.cn: resolvere 意为彻底解开或溶解。

items.en: Resolutus is the past participle, loosened or settled.
items.cn: resolutus 是过去分词，意为已解开、已定下。

items.en: Resolver means to resolve or settle.
items.cn: resolver 意为解决、定下。

items.en: Middle English resolven covers solving and deciding.
items.cn: 中古英语 resolven 兼指解决与决定。

items.en: Modern English adds the technical sense of separating into parts.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「分解为部分」的技术义项。

note.en: Resolve is a loosening verb, and it sits near its family and near verbs for solving and deciding.
note.cn: resolve 是一个「松开」动词，与自身词族以及表示解决和决定的动词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Resolve contains solvere, to loosen: solving a problem is loosening a knot.

normal.en: Re- means back or completely, and solvere means loosen.
normal.cn: re- 表示回或彻底，solvere 表示松开。

normal.en: Resolve a dispute is the common phrase.
normal.cn: resolve a dispute 是常见短语。

normal.en: Resolve to do something means decide firmly.
normal.cn: resolve to do something 意为坚定决定去做。

normal.en: The noun is resolution, the same loosening.
normal.cn: 名词是 resolution，同样是「解开」。

normal.en: Compare solve: solve finds the answer, while resolve often ends a conflict.
normal.cn: 对比 solve：solve 找出答案，resolve 常结束冲突。

abstract.en: Picture a knot loosening under patient fingers.
abstract.cn: 想象绳结在耐心的手指下慢慢松开。

abstract.en: Imagine two people shaking hands after a long argument.
abstract.cn: 想象两人长谈后握手言和。

abstract.en: Think of muddy water settling until it is clear.
abstract.cn: 想象浑水渐渐沉淀变清。

examples.en: The two families resolved their dispute.
examples.cn: 两家人解决了他们的争端。

examples.en: She resolved to speak to him that evening.
examples.cn: 她决心那天晚上和他谈一谈。

examples.en: The mixture resolved into two clear layers.
examples.cn: 混合物分成了两层清澈的液体。

sensesIntro.en: The verb loosens a problem, settles a wavering mind, and can also describe a whole separating into layers.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词把问题松开、把摇摆的心思定下，也可描述整体分离成层。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a knot loosened until the cord lies flat.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳结被解开，绳子平直。

branches.en: Ending a problem is the core loosening sense.
branches.cn: 结束问题，是核心的「解开」义项。

branches.en: A firm decision settles the mind.
branches.cn: 坚定的决定让心思安定。

branches.en: Separating into parts is a whole coming loose.
branches.cn: 分解成部分，是整体松开。

branches.en: Solving and deciding both remove inner or outer confusion.
branches.cn: 解决与决定都消除内在或外在的混乱。

branches.en: A settled decision and a settled mixture both become clear.
branches.cn: 定下的决定与沉淀的混合物都变得清楚。

definition_en: a place people go for holidays, or the use of something as a last option
core_image: 海边一排小屋，人们拖着行李来这里放松几天
scene: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地挤满了来自北方的游客。In high season the seaside resort is crowded with visitors from the north.
sceneCN: 这里 resort 是「度假胜地」（第 1 个义项：人们去度假的地方）；句意：旺季时这座海滨度假胜地挤满了来自北方的游客。

pos.zh: 度假胜地；手段；应急办法

senses.title: A place for holidays
senses.definition: a place where many people go to relax on holiday
senses.definitionCN: 许多人前往放松度假的地方
senses.example: The seaside resort is crowded in high season.
senses.exampleCN: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地很拥挤。
senses.why: A resort is first a place people turn to for rest and pleasure.
senses.whyCN: resort 首先指人们为了休息和享乐而前往的地方。

senses.title: A last option or means
senses.definition: something used because no better option is available
senses.definitionCN: 因为没有更好选择而采用的办法
senses.example: As a last resort, we can walk home.
senses.exampleCN: 实在不行，我们可以走回家。
senses.why: The place one turns to becomes any resource one turns to in difficulty.
senses.whyCN: 所前往的地方，变成困难时所求助的任何手段。

senses.title: To turn to something for help
senses.definition: to use something, often reluctantly, because it is the only way left
senses.definitionCN: 因别无他法而使用某物，常带不情愿
senses.example: They had to resort to legal action.
senses.exampleCN: 他们不得不诉诸法律行动。
senses.why: The verb keeps the image of turning toward a place of help.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留「转向求助之处」的意象。

intro.en: Resort comes from Old French resort, a place resorted to, from resortir, to go back or go out again.
intro.cn: resort 来自古法语 resort（人们常去之处），源于 resortir（再出去、返回）。

items.en: Sortir means to go out.
items.cn: sortir 意为出去。

items.en: Resortir means to go back or come out again.
items.cn: resortir 意为返回、再出去。

items.en: Resort names a place people resort to.
items.cn: resort 指人们常去的地方。

items.en: Middle English resort means a place of assembly or help.
items.cn: 中古英语 resort 指聚集或求助之处。

items.en: Resort is used for places of holiday and pleasure.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，resort 用于度假与游乐之地。

items.en: Modern English adds the phrase as a last resort.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了 as a last resort 这一说法。

note.en: Resort is a turning-to word, and it sits near its family and near words for destinations and options.
note.cn: resort 是一个「转向」词，与自身词族以及表示目的地和选择的词相邻。

entries.definition: third person form of resort
entries.definitionCN: resort 的第三人称单数形式

entries.definition: past form of resort
a person who often visits resorts
the place someone is travelling to
a choice available in a situation
a place of safety or help

normalIntro.en: Resort is a place one turns to: first a holiday place, then any last option.
normalIntro.cn: resort 是人转向的地方：先指度假地，再指任何最后手段。

normal.en: The verb resort to means turn to something for help.
normal.cn: 动词 resort to 意为求助于某物。

normal.en: A seaside resort is a place people travel to.
normal.cn: seaside resort 是人们前往的海滨度假地。

normal.en: As a last resort marks the final option.
normal.cn: as a last resort 标记最后的选择。

normal.en: The same word covers a place and a choice.
normal.cn: 同一个词既指地方，也指选择。

normal.en: Compare destination: destination is neutral, while resort suggests leisure.
normal.cn: 对比 destination：destination 中性，resort 带有休闲意味。

abstract.en: Picture suitcases rolling along a promenade.
abstract.cn: 想象行李箱沿着海滨步道滚动。

abstract.en: Imagine an empty road leading to the only open door.
abstract.cn: 想象一条空路通向唯一还开着的门。

abstract.en: Think of a hand reaching for the last tool in a box.
abstract.cn: 想象手伸向盒子里最后一件工具。

examples.en: The seaside resort is crowded in high season.
examples.cn: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地很拥挤。

examples.en: As a last resort, we can walk home.
examples.cn: 实在不行，我们可以走回家。

examples.en: They had to resort to legal action.
examples.cn: 他们不得不诉诸法律行动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + sort」——再次出发去某个地方，先想到的是度假地，最后才当作手段；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 sortir（出去）→ resortir（返回、再出去）→ resort（人们常去之处）→ 中古英语 resort → 现代英语 resort。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins with a place people travel to for rest, then becomes any option people turn to when nothing better remains.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从人们前往休息的地方开始，再变成别无更好选择时所求助的任何手段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place people turn toward for rest or help.
core.cn: 核心意象：人们为了休息或求助而转向的地方。

branches.en: A holiday place is the most concrete sense.
branches.cn: 度假地，是最具体的义项。

branches.en: A last option is the place image turned abstract.
branches.cn: 最后手段，是「地方」意象的抽象化。

branches.en: The verb describes turning to that option.
branches.cn: 动词描述转向那个办法。

branches.en: People travel to a resort, and people turn to a last resort.
branches.cn: 人们前往度假地，也转向最后手段。

branches.en: The option and the act of using it are two sides of the same word.
branches.cn: 办法与使用办法的行为是同一个词的两面。

intro.en: Resort is a French noun and verb that English reshaped, and its small family grows with English endings.
intro.cn: resort 是经英语改造的法语名词兼动词，小词族由英语词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: The French verb sortir means to go out, and resortir means to come back or go out again; the Latin prefix re- adds the return.
latinIntro.cn: 法语动词 sortir 意为出去，resortir 意为返回或再出去；拉丁前缀 re- 增添「返回」。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of returning.

items.meaning: to go back, come out again
items.example: Resortir joins the prefix and the verb.
items.exampleCN: resortir 把前缀与动词结合。

items.meaning: a holiday place or last option
items.example: Resort keeps both place and option senses.
items.exampleCN: resort 保留场所与办法两种含义。

items.example: Seaside resort is a common compound.
items.exampleCN: seaside resort 是常见复合词。

definition_en: something useful that can be used to achieve a goal
core_image: 仓库里整齐码放着工具、材料和食物，随时可以取用
scene: 岛上淡水有限，居民很早就学会珍惜每一份资源。Fresh water is limited on the island, so residents learned early to value every resource.
sceneCN: 这里 resource 是「资源」（第 1 个义项：可利用的有用之物）；句意：岛上淡水有限，居民很早就学会珍惜每一份资源。

senses.title: A useful supply
senses.definition: a supply of something such as water, fuel, or money that can be used
senses.definitionCN: 水、燃料或资金等可供使用的供应
senses.example: The country is rich in natural resources.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家自然资源丰富。
senses.why: The word names a source to which one can return for help.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指可以反复回来求助的来源。

senses.title: Personal ability to cope
senses.definition: the ability to find a way through a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 在困难处境中找到出路的能力
senses.example: She showed great resource in a crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 她在危机中表现出很强的应变能力。
senses.why: A person's inner reserves are a resource drawn on in trouble.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的内在储备，就是困难时可取用的资源。

senses.title: A teaching or reference material
senses.definition: a book, website, or other material used for learning or reference
senses.definitionCN: 用于学习或查阅的书、网站或其他材料
senses.example: The website is a useful resource for teachers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个网站对教师来说是很有用的资源。
senses.why: Any material one can draw on for a task is a resource.
senses.whyCN: 任何可供任务取用的材料都是资源。

intro.en: Resource comes from French ressource, a source of help, from Old French resourdre, to rise again, ultimately Latin resurgere.
intro.cn: resource 来自法语 ressource（求助之源），源于古法语 resourdre（重新升起），最终来自拉丁语 resurgere。

items.en: Surgere means to rise.
items.cn: surgere 意为升起。

items.en: Resurgere means to rise again.
items.cn: resurgere 意为重新升起。

items.en: Resourdre means to rise again or recover.
items.cn: resourdre 意为再起、恢复。

items.en: Ressource means a source of help or recovery.
items.cn: ressource 意为求助或恢复的来源。

items.en: English resource covers means of support and available supplies.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，英语 resource 涵盖支持手段与可用物资。

items.en: Modern English often uses the plural for a country's wealth.
items.cn: 现代英语常用复数指一个国家的财富。

note.en: Resource is a source one draws on, and it sits near its family and near words for supplies and means.
note.cn: resource 是一个可取用的来源，与自身词族以及表示供应和手段的词相邻。

entries.definition: good at finding ways to solve problems
in a clever and practical way
the ability to cope cleverly
an amount of something available
something valuable that can be used
a method or resource for doing something

normalIntro.en: Resource is a source one can rise back to: something useful kept ready.
normalIntro.cn: resource 是一个可以回头依靠的来源：随时备好的有用之物。

normal.en: The re- suggests rising again when needed.
normal.cn: re- 暗示需要时能再站起来。

normal.en: Natural resources are supplies taken from the earth.
normal.cn: 自然资源取自大地。

normal.en: Human resources are the people an organisation can draw on.
normal.cn: 人力资源是组织可以依靠的人。

normal.en: A resourceful person finds a way with very little.
normal.cn: resourceful 的人用很少的东西也能找到办法。

normal.en: Compare source: a source supplies, while a resource is a source you can use.
normal.cn: 对比 source：source 提供来源，resource 是可供你使用的来源。

abstract.en: Picture shelves of tools and food neatly stacked.
abstract.cn: 想象架子上整齐放着工具和食物。

abstract.en: Imagine a small boat with one oar used cleverly.
abstract.cn: 想象一条小船，靠一支桨巧妙前行。

abstract.en: Think of a teacher's box of ready-made materials.
abstract.cn: 想象老师一盒备好的教学材料。

examples.en: The country is rich in natural resources.
examples.cn: 这个国家自然资源丰富。

examples.en: She showed great resource in a crisis.
examples.cn: 她在危机中表现出很强的应变能力。

examples.en: The website is a useful resource for teachers.
examples.cn: 这个网站对教师来说是很有用的资源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + source」——可以反复回去取用的来源，就是资源；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 surgere（升起）→ resurgere（再起）→ 古法语 resourdre → ressource（求助之源）→ 现代英语 resource。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with a source of help one can return to, then covers material supplies, inner coping ability, and learning materials.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从可以回去求助的来源开始，再涵盖物资储备、内在应变能力与学习材料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a store of useful things ready to be drawn on.
core.cn: 核心意象：一批随时可取用的有用之物。

branches.en: Material supply is the basic modern sense.
branches.cn: 物资供应，是基本现代义项。

branches.en: Inner ability is a resource stored in a person.
branches.cn: 内在能力，是储存在人身上的资源。

branches.en: Learning material is a resource drawn on for a task.
branches.cn: 学习材料是为任务取用的资源。

branches.en: Countries and people both draw on reserves in hard times.
branches.cn: 国家与人都会在困难时动用储备。

branches.en: A clever person and a good website both help solve problems.
branches.cn: 聪明的人与好网站都能帮助解决问题。

intro.en: Resource is a French-shaped noun built on the Latin verb for rising again, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: resource 是建立在拉丁语「再起」动词上的法语形态名词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin surgere means to rise, and resurgere means to rise again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 surgere 意为升起，resurgere 意为重新升起。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of rising again.
Resurgere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: resurgere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Resourdre carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: resourdre 把这个动词带入法语。

items.example: Ressource is the direct source of resource.
items.exampleCN: ressource 是 resource 的直接来源。
resource 保留「求助之源」的含义。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的词尾

definition_en: a feeling of admiration, or a particular aspect of something
core_image: 一个人后退半步，认真看着对方，身体微微前倾
scene: 那位老教师走进教室时，所有学生都站起来表示敬意。When the old teacher entered the classroom, every student stood up to show respect.
sceneCN: 这里 respect 是「敬意」（第 1 个义项：对某人怀有的钦佩与重视）；句意：老教师走进教室时，所有学生都站起来表示敬意。

senses.title: Admiration and esteem
senses.definition: a feeling of admiration for someone because of their qualities or achievements
senses.definitionCN: 因某人的品质或成就而钦佩他
senses.example: Every student stood up to show respect.
senses.exampleCN: 每个学生都站起来表示敬意。
senses.why: The Latin word means a looking back at someone, and that look becomes esteem.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词意为回头注视某人，这种注视就变成敬意。

senses.title: A particular aspect
senses.definition: one detail or point in which things can be compared
senses.definitionCN: 事物可以相互比较的某个细节或要点
senses.example: In this respect, the two plans are alike.
senses.exampleCN: 在这方面，两项计划很相似。
senses.why: Looking back at a thing can mean looking at one particular side of it.
senses.whyCN: 「回头看某物」也可以指看它的某一个侧面。

senses.title: To admire and treat well
senses.definition: to admire someone and treat them with care and fairness
senses.definitionCN: 钦佩某人并以体贴、公平的方式对待他
senses.example: She respects her teacher greatly.
senses.exampleCN: 她非常尊敬她的老师。
senses.why: The noun's esteem becomes the verb's way of acting toward someone.
senses.whyCN: 名词的「敬意」变成动词对待某人的方式。

intro.en: Respect comes from Latin respectus, a looking back, from respicere, to look back at, built on re- and specere, to look.
intro.cn: respect 来自拉丁语 respectus（回顾），源于 respicere（回头看），由 re- 与 specere（看）构成。

items.en: Specere means to look at.
items.cn: specere 意为看。

items.en: Respicere means to look back at or consider.
items.cn: respicere 意为回头看、考虑。

items.en: Respectus means a looking back or regard.
items.cn: respectus 意为回顾、注目。

items.en: Respect means regard or consideration.
items.cn: respect 意为重视、考虑。

items.en: Middle English respect covers esteem and a particular point.
items.cn: 中古英语 respect 兼指敬意与某个方面。

items.en: Modern English uses respect as both noun and verb.
items.cn: 现代英语中，respect 兼作名词与动词。

note.en: Respect is a looking-back word, and it sits near its family and near words for esteem and regard.
note.cn: respect 是一个「回头看」的词，与自身词族以及表示敬重和关注的词相邻。

entries.definition: showing respect
in a respectful way
belonging separately to each one
great respect and admiration
respect or attention for someone
public respect or a mark of it

normalIntro.en: Respect contains specere, to look: respect begins with looking at someone properly.
normalIntro.cn: respect 含有 specere（看）：尊重始于认真注视对方。

normal.en: Re- means back, and specere means look: to look back with regard.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，specere 表示看：带着重视回头看。

normal.en: Show respect is the common phrase.
normal.cn: show respect 是常见短语。

normal.en: In this respect means in this particular aspect.
normal.cn: in this respect 意为「在这方面」。

normal.en: Respectful is the adjective for showing regard.
normal.cn: respectful 是表示「恭敬的」形容词。

normal.en: Compare esteem: esteem is admiration, while respect also includes fair treatment.
normal.cn: 对比 esteem：esteem 是钦佩，respect 还包括公平对待。

abstract.en: Picture a student standing as a teacher enters.
abstract.cn: 想象老师进门时学生站起来。

abstract.en: Imagine a listener putting down the phone to look at you.
abstract.cn: 想象听者放下手机，认真看着你。

abstract.en: Think of a slight bow before a serious conversation.
abstract.cn: 想象严肃谈话前微微躬身。

examples.en: Every student stood up to show respect.
examples.cn: 每个学生都站起来表示敬意。

examples.en: In this respect, the two plans are alike.
examples.cn: 在这方面，两项计划很相似。

examples.en: She respects her teacher greatly.
examples.cn: 她非常尊敬她的老师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + spect」——回头再看一眼，是因为心里看重，所以尊重；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 specere（看）→ respicere（回头看）→ respectus（回顾、注目）→ 古法语 respect → 现代英语 respect。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins with a backward look of regard, which becomes esteem, then a particular side of a thing, and finally the way one treats another person.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从带着重视的回头注视开始，变成敬意，再指事物的某个侧面，最后指对待他人的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pausing to look at someone with attention and care.
core.cn: 核心意象：停下来，带着关注与体贴看着某人。

branches.en: Esteem is the feeling produced by that careful look.
branches.cn: 敬意是由认真注视产生的感受。

branches.en: A respect is one side of a thing seen closely.
branches.cn: 「方面」是近距离观察到的某个侧面。

branches.en: The verb turns esteem into fair treatment.
branches.cn: 动词把敬意变成公平对待。

branches.en: Feeling respect and acting respectfully belong together.
branches.cn: 心怀敬意与以礼相待彼此相连。

branches.en: Attention to detail and attention to people share the same look.
branches.cn: 关注细节与关注他人共享同一种注视。

intro.en: Respect is a Latin noun and verb carried through French, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: respect 是经法语传递的拉丁名词兼动词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin specere means to look, and respicere means to look back at or consider.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 specere 意为看，respicere 意为回头看、考虑。

items.exampleCN: re- 增添「回头看」的意思。

items.example: Respicere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: respicere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Respective shares the same Latin stem.
items.exampleCN: respective 共享同一拉丁词干。
